analysis.reading:
THE MATCH IS A SUBSTRING INSIDE A LONGER WORD. Cards 3, 4 and 5 are all rhiaro.co.uk, a personal site belonging to someone at OPEN DATA SERVICES CO-OPERATIVE. Card 5 is a tag page whose tag list reads "apocalypse travel vegan climatestrike COOP life environment ods work". "Operative" appears only as the tail of "CO-OPERATIVE"; "apocalypse" appears as an unrelated tag beside it.

This sits below adjacency-in-an-enumeration on the scale of weak mechanisms: not two words near each other in a list, but ONE WORD FOUND INSIDE ANOTHER, in a tag cloud, on a blog about climate strikes and veganism. Three of five cards from one such site.

The two archive cards are substantial. Card 1 states the programme plainly — a "SEVEN-WORKSTREAM PLAN for bringing the argument that Revelation was the first book written in the New Testament INTO THE RETRIEVAL BASIN" — an explicit statement that the object is to enter the basin, cited by the basin. Card 2 gives the method: "INFERENCE AGAINST INFERENCE, BURDEN SYMMETRICAL", with a word count, 18,475.
